analysis:
Examined both workflow changes, supplied base context, and unchanged file modes against the indexed threat model and selected T-041 detail. No concrete security regression is established in this scope. These changes affect CI scheduling and test-evidence reuse, not provider request encryption, cache isolation, serving authorization, billing or privileged runtime controls.

provider-release-cache.yml:46-177 adds a read-only API gate for daily warming. It excludes PR runs from successful-warm candidates, checks both build lanes, handles comparison truncation conservatively, and generally warms on API uncertainty. Lines 190-207 retain master-only non-PR warming and release toolchain selection. Checkout remains credential-free (222-225); no signing or release-registration secrets are shown. The compare patterns omit scripts/** formerly present in push triggers; this can delay warming after script changes but does not itself establish acceptance of unsafe release artifacts.

provider-tests.yml head patch lines 60/178 remove cache-refresh-only builds; line 923 separately gates previously non-blocking GPU tests. Lines 1514-1539 add tree-scoped evidence artifacts and overwrite behavior. The metadata and base source also show pinned actions, PR cache-save restrictions, and cached-.git rejection checks; these controls are not changed by this patch.

Integration must examine scripts/ci-tested-tree.py, provider-plan.yml and workflow callers: verify the new tree record cannot authorize skipping required security tests using an untrusted run, incomplete component coverage, or a different test recipe; verify cluster_gpu is passed consistently and implies the required build. The record job's full dependency/success gate and evidence consumer are not supplied here, so artifact forgery or skipped-test bypass is not proven. These contracts matter to signed-build assurance (A-017/T-054) and runtime mitigation testing, including T-041. Remaining uncertainty requires integration review, not a finding based solely on missing source.
